project_summary: Insurance policy administration system with actuarial rating engine and claims workflow

components.name: Policy lifecycle management
components.description: CRUD for policies, endorsements, and renewals with state machine transitions and document generation (PDF).

components.name: Actuarial rating engine
components.description: Rule-based premium calculation with configurable factors, batch recalculation jobs, and audit of rating decisions.

components.name: Claims intake and adjudication
components.description: Multi-step claims forms, fraud scoring hooks, and adjuster assignment workflow with SLA tracking.

components.name: Broker integration API
components.description: REST and SOAP endpoints for external brokers with mutual TLS and contract versioning.

components.name: Regulatory reporting module
components.description: Scheduled exports for Solvency II metrics and internal management dashboards.
